scoring.PASS: Visible/reference-level question answered with direct, source-identified evidence and no material contradiction; never infer native proof
scoring.ISSUE: Observed defect or normative contradiction supported by an explicit source/owner observation
scoring.UNVERIFIED: No sufficient source, image, interaction trace, on-device evidence or independent reproduction to decide
scoring.NOT_APPLICABLE: Not in documented product scope; must explain why
scoring.weightedCoverage: sum of PASS and ISSUE weights / sum of applicable weights; not a quality score
scoring.quality: Pass-weight / (Pass-weight + Issue-weight) among assessed only; always report assessed coverage alongside

prep: exact current main and PR branch head
formal: review all 60 with source citations per question
tier issue severity and evidence provenance
link findings to spec and proposal revisions
reraster changed mockups and record before/after
do not self-approve design or claim native acceptance
